purpose: single-use final promotion acceptance for the next frozen candidate
canonicalization: after complete coverage only: for each data/frozen/*.csv in bytewise filename order, hash filename newline and then CSV rows whose date is within the inclusive window

preregistered_acceptance.hard_account_constraints: gross<=100%, single<=60%, positions<=6, no leverage, no short

rules: The consumed 2026-07-21 through 2026-08-05 promotion set and result remain immutable audit evidence and must never be reused as a final holdback.
Do not inspect prices, signals, fills, returns, or acceptance metrics in this future window while developing or tuning this candidate.
Do not evaluate any strategy metric until all 12 expected sessions are present in every frozen symbol file and a canonical data hash has been sealed.
Evaluate this window once, only after the candidate code, configuration, validation code, and all non-holdback gates remain frozen and match the preregistered hashes.
Any production, validation, test, or configuration change invalidates this preregistration and requires a newly acquired future holdback.

The activation transition may only record complete coverage, symbol/file counts, data-row counts, snapshot identity, and the canonical hash; it may not change the window, gates, candidate hashes, or rules.
A failed metric evaluation is final for this candidate and requires a new candidate plus a newly acquired future holdback.
